definitionZh: 元素移动的速度和方向。当中断时，弹簧将其带入下一个动画，因此轻弹的元素保持其速度。
sourceDefinition: How fast and in which direction an element is moving. A spring carries it into the next animation when interrupted, so a flicked element keeps its speed.
